paper.title_en: UFO Sightings with Matchete: Connecting BSM Lagrangians with Event Generators
paper.abstract_en: We present a tool for the automated generation of Universal Feynman Output (UFO) files, used as input by many event generators, for generic Beyond the Standard Model (BSM) theories and their low-energy Effective Field Theory (EFT) descriptions. Building on the Matchete package, which provides a convenient interface for defining BSM models and deriving their EFTs via matching, our extension obtains the Lagrangian in the broken phase of the electroweak symmetry, performs automatic gauge fixing, computes all Feynman rules, imposes flavor symmetries, and exports the model in the UFO format. This significantly streamlines BSM and EFT analyses, as we illustrate with an EFT validity study for a multi-channel leptoquark search. As an application, we provide a complete UFO implementation of the Standard Model EFT up to dimension eight using the $M_W$ electroweak input scheme.
